highlights.excerpt:
We recently migrated our Messages API from Python to Rust.

On our engineering blog, we share how we used the existing service to verify the new one, with teams of Claude agents tracking down and fixing differences between the two versions.

https://t.co/NdrMzgrOwP

在工程博客中，我们分享了如何用现有服务来验证新服务，由多组 Claude 智能体追踪并修复两个版本之间的差异。

highlights.excerpt:
We’re now testing Private Inference, our latest offering as part of OpenAI Private Intelligence, with a small group of customers.

Stronger privacy protections will make frontier AI useful for a lot more work, and business privacy is important for a healthy ecosystem. Reach out to @shekar4x if interested!
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们正在与一小部分客户测试 Private Inference，这是 OpenAI Private Intelligence 的最新能力。

更强的隐私保护将让前沿 AI 能用于更多工作，而商业隐私对健康的生态很重要。有兴趣请联系 @shekar4x！

highlights.text_zh: OpenAI 开始小范围测试 Private Inference，强化企业隐私与无人员查看的安全审核。
